I've been disappointed by similar products before, so quality really matters to me.

I really hear you. When you’ve been let down before, it makes every new purchase feel risky, especially with plants that you’re hoping to enjoy for years.

A quick bit of reassurance about quality here:

We grow all of our own-root roses ourselves at our nurseries in Oregon; we don’t buy from third-party growers.
Plants are true to variety, grown on their own roots (not grafted), and shipped in 1-gallon containers with soil, defoliated so they travel well.
Every rose is covered by a one-year guarantee, and perennials by a 90-day guarantee, because we expect them to establish well when planted and cared for correctly.

From here, I want to make sure we choose exactly what fits your situation so you’re happy with it long term.
